    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">线条小人动画制作 -开源项目自荐</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="blog-content" style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, &quot;Roboto&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; line-height: 1.8; color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1)">
<div class="intro-section" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(102, 126, 234, 1) 0, rgba(118, 75, 162, 1) 100%); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); padding: 30px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 25px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3)">
<h2 style="margin: 0 0 15px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600">✨ 灵感来源</h2>
<p style="margin: 0; font-size: 16px; opacity: 0.95">年会，舞蹈表演，不会&amp;不会教别人，所以写了一个小项目——线条小人动画制作器！</p>
</div>
<div class="description-section" style="background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); padding: 25px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(102, 126, 234, 1)">
<p style="margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 16px">🎯 <strong>项目简介：</strong>调整关节，可以导出 4 拍或者 8 拍的视频。</p>
<p style="margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1)">💡 大家都知道，年会随便弄弄就行了，随便跳跳就行。主要是这次是让我领别人跳，所以这个项目诞生了</p>
<div class="project-link" style="background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 20px 0; border: 2px solid rgba(102, 126, 234, 1)">
<p style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px">🔗 <strong>项目地址：</strong> <a style="color: rgba(102, 126, 234, 1); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s ease" href="https://github.com/UokyI/line-figure-animation" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"> UokyI/line-figure-animation: 线条小人动画 🚀 </a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="features-section" style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 245, 245, 1), rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)); padding: 25px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 25px; border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 107, 107, 1)">
<h3 style="color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 1); font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center"><span style="font-size: 24px; margin-right: 8px">🎨</span> 核心功能</h3>
<ul style="list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 0">
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 25px; position: relative; font-size: 16px"><span style="position: absolute; left: 0; color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 1)">✓</span> 自定义线条小人动作（可自行调整关节位置 + 关节长度）</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 25px; position: relative; font-size: 16px"><span style="position: absolute; left: 0; color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 1)">✓</span> 指定关键帧 &amp; 节拍数</li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 25px; position: relative; font-size: 16px"><span style="position: absolute; left: 0; color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 1)">✓</span> 导出 MP4 视频，或者直接本地播放</li>
</ul>
</div>
